rows.label: tlk70000024_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Hey, you! Ryuuryuu will teach you our
new prank that doubles as training,
mo.

rows.label: tlk70000024_04_msg0002
rows.name:
First, second brother Kachocho trips
the target up...

rows.label: tlk70000024_04_msg0003
rows.name:
Then third brother Yokuyoku launches
the target high into the air...

rows.label: tlk70000024_04_msg0004
rows.name:
Finally, fourth brother Komeme slams
the target into the ground to finish,
mo!

rows.label: tlk70000024_04_msg0005
rows.name:
Mo? You want to say Ryuuryuu isn't
doing anything... Is that it, mo?

rows.label: tlk70000024_04_msg0006
rows.name:
Tsk, tsk... Ryuuryuu is the director
of this prank, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000024_04_msg0007
rows.name:
Unless Ryuuryuu gives the brothers
perfectly timed instructions, this
prank won't work, mo.
